verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature docs mention pre-built templates for agile sprints, burndown charts, capacity management, and board views, which shows first-party sprint-oriented capability. The evidence is thin marketing copy with no detailed documentation of the sprint lifecycle itself. One community report says it is hard to see which tickets were in a closed sprint, which points to a usability gap rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: documentation of creating, starting and completing sprints, backlog-to-sprint planning, velocity and sprint reports, and independent hands-on corroboration of sprint management.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development

citations.quote: Start fast with pre-built and customizable templates for any project, from agile sprints to marketing campaigns.
Keep work on track whether you're measuring engineering cycle time, burn down charts, or managing capacity.
Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
